note: Control registry for the synthetic evidence manifest (docs/ASSURANCE-AND-CERTIFICATION.md AS-01..AS-04). Owners are roles to assign, not evidence of staffing. A passing test is evidence for review, not certification.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: control-to-evidence traceability for this repository
controls.requirement: Trace each control to requirement, implementation, test, release and evidence; stale or missing evidence never passes.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: REST, MCP, worker and database policy for synthetic tasks and proposals
controls.requirement: Least privilege, current membership, revocation and scoped agents across every surface.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: committed-change audit, independent denial audit, privacy-safe diagnostics, restore
controls.requirement: Protected successful-change and independent denial audit; privacy-safe diagnostics.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: dependency inventory, SBOM and evidence integrity (no signed release exists)
controls.requirement: Approved changes, reproducible dependency inventory, SBOM/provenance, signed releases and vulnerability remediation.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: recovery drill, downtime procedure, backup verification and escalation (workstream M; embedded test cluster only, no deployment)
controls.requirement: Timed restore into an isolated target reconciles every tenant table and journal entry and reports measured RTO/RPO against recommended-pending-approval objectives with any gap named; an incomplete backup is detected.
